# Gadget Repairs Glasgow

> Professional Mobile Phone & Tablet Repair, Unlocking, and Accessories — based on Trongate in Glasgow city centre. 4.9★ rated by 150+ customers, 10+ years experience, same-day repairs with a 12-month warranty.

## About

Gadget Repairs Glasgow is a trusted, locally-run repair shop at 172 Trongate, Glasgow, UK. For over 10 years we have fixed cracked screens, dead batteries, faulty charging ports, software issues and liquid damage for thousands of happy customers across Glasgow and the surrounding areas. Our certified technicians use premium parts and offer a no-fix, no-fee guarantee on most repairs.

Walk in, book online, or use our free doorstep collection service — most repairs are completed the same day. We repair iPhone, Samsung Galaxy, Google Pixel, Huawei, Xiaomi and all major smartphone and tablet brands.

- Address: 172 Trongate, Glasgow, UK
- Phone: +44 7777 200149
- Email: info@gadgetrepairsglasgow.co.uk
- Hours: Monday–Saturday 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM, Sunday 11:00 AM – 5:00 PM
- Rating: 4.9 / 5 from 150+ reviews

## Services

- **Phone Repairs & Diagnostics** — hardware/software troubleshooting, charging port, camera, water damage. From £25.
- **Network Unlocking Services** — permanent factory unlock for any carrier worldwide. From £15.
- **Tablet & iPad Solutions** — screen, battery, port, speaker and button repairs. From £40.
- **Display & Glass Replacement** — cracked/unresponsive LCD & OLED screen replacement. From £45.
- **Battery Health Solutions** — degraded/swelling battery replacement. From £30.
- **Device Trade-In & Sales** — buy certified pre-owned or sell your device. From £50.
- **Mobile Accessories** — cases, screen protectors, chargers, cables, audio. From £5.
- **Water Damage Recovery** — ultrasonic cleaning & component-level repair. From £40.

## Service Areas

Trongate, Mile-end, Laurieston, Cessnock, Stobcross, Haghill, Riddrie, Newbank, Petershill, Oakbank, Shawfield, Hazelwood — plus free doorstep collection across Glasgow.
